title: E0 - Desirability and Viability
description: Persona research, customer journey mapping, JTBD, market viability, pitch narrative. Mandatory before any code.

title: E1 - Project Scaffold
description: Python project init, FastAPI skeleton, Streamlit skeleton, Pydantic domain models.

title: E2 - Data Layer
description: Ember carbon, PyPSA-Eur grid, GridSFM-Open congestion inference, OSM substations, NUTS2 geo, land cost. Fallback chain: PyPSA -> GridSFM -> ENTSO-E.

title: E3 - Rule-Based Scoring Engine
description: 5-dimension weighted composite scorer. Signal A of the triple-signal system. Pure Python, fully testable.

title: E3b - NPV Model
description: DCF model: capex + opex + revenue -> NPV per NUTS2 zone. Signal B.

title: E3c - ML Signal Layer
description: Random Forest classifier + NPV regression trained on gridfm-datakit synthetic data. Signal C. SHAP explainability required. Confluence logic combines A+B+C into STRONG/CAUTION/AGAINST.

title: E4 - Supply Mix Engine
description: LCOE model, PPA opportunity flagging, supply mix optimizer.

title: E5 - Map and UI
description: NUTS2 choropleth, layer toggles, filter panel (MW + m2 inputs), drill-down with signal badge, narrative generator.

title: E6 - Integration and Demo
description: Unit tests across all engines, E2E integration tests, demo scenarios, README.
